purpose: prospective synthetic general-reset, related-source, partial-lifetime state banks at the frozen nine targets
prior_independent_labels: permanently excluded; original coefficients as an immutable total-bank diagnostic baseline only
grouping: one semantic synthetic source and all its exact clock/stage variants stay in one split; normalized semantic signatures must be unique across sources
reset: synchronous active-low; per-channel zero/ones/alternating/hash-derived general bit patterns; same logical value reset along its lifetime
source_relations: kept combinational bit permutation/inversion adapters over shared registered roots; distinct semantic words, common dynamic input bits; adapter logic explicitly excluded from state ownership
relation_limit: affine wiring adapters exercise source sharing; qualification of arbitrary arithmetic correlations belongs to the joint G model, not inferred from S alone
lifetime: contiguous native lifetime; include no-full-chain layouts; channels born after first cut and channels ending before last cut; valid always advances inside native bank
known_bits: all dynamic, high/low zero padding, interior zero holes including 37-bit/36-variable and66-bit/64-variable layouts
service_protocols: one shared write enable including input-valid
independent data write enables with continuously advancing input-valid
external_protocol: unconditional output data/valid capture from declared terminal native values; never gated by valid
ownership: disjoint input_service/native_state/external_state/adapter/observer/shared_clock/shared_physical/root_boundary_repair; retain every class; unknown functional cells or FF geometry mismatches reject
diagnostic_baseline: immutable_native_total_baseline; original unpartitioned total is not eligible as a per-owner joint addend
model_features: semantic bits/signals/reset-one bits/capture-enable domains/widths/known masks/shared-source and lifetime descriptors/SDC only; no mapped cell counts, timing, area or source/split IDs
state_area_label: input_service, native_state and external_state owned functional state/control area separately; shared physical/clock/repair labels retained separately, never silently added twice to a joint stage
selection: train-only nonnegative least squares; original gates on validation; normalized MAE, serialized size and stable candidate order break ties; parameters/domain/reserve frozen before fresh test

boundary.birth_adapter_path: diagnostic only; not a state-only control bound or D_ref
boundary.test_gate: per exact clock and path class cover independent maxima without changing reserve

mapping_reuse: none in this cohort; each target gets independent synthesis and fresh SDC/ODB; all leaves paid
